notes.title: Help Yet Another Fantasy Title Win "Best Game You Suck At" in the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hello Rogues and Wizards,
To all the brave souls who dared to step into the chaotic, unforgiving world of Yet Another Fantasy Title (YAFT): we see you! You've faced absurd traps, relentless enemies, and those frustrating moments where success felt just out of reach. And yet, despite all the challenges, you kept coming back for more.

YAFT is not just another fantasy game - it's a test of skill, patience, and maybe even your sanity. It's about embracing the chaos, laughing through the struggle, and celebrating every hard-earned victory. If this game has pushed your limits and made you love (and hate) every second, then it’s the perfect contender for the "Best Game You Suck At" category.

So, if YAFT has made you scream, laugh, and persevere like never before, show it some love in this year’s Steam Awards. Let's make it official: YAFT is the game we all love to suck at!

Yours truly,
YAFT team

notes.title: Here is a summary of the changes and fixes!
notes.content:
Hello,

here is a summary of the changes and fixes introduced in the recent builds:

- important change: a series of major and minor changes aimed at reducing instances where players get stuck on obstacles,
- change: disabling increased damage when a player takes damage from behind,
- fix: adjustment of control mechanics for fast movement on the gamepad,
- fix: colliders and hitboxes of trolls,
- fix: changes to movement speed for certain horses and wolves,
- fix: icons of bandit camps on the map,
- fix: ability to collect already owned weapons,
- fixes: typos in the text.

notes.title: HOTFIX #1: Save system is working properly now!
notes.content:
Hello Rogues and Wizards,
Thank you for reporting the problem with the saves system. We've fixed it ASAP. This hotfix is focused on enabling you the option of continuing the game from the main menu. 

About the saves system
The game saves itself after each fully completed quest. It also has checkpoints during each of the quests. So if you die in the middle of the quest, you get "teleported" to the last checkpoint of that quest. 

However, if you quit the game in the middle of the quest, you will have to start it from the beginning upon returning to the game.

We hope this helps!

Go and do magic, Wizards!
YAFT team

notes.title: Three days to launch!
notes.content:
Three days to launch! The last few days have been an incredibly intense period. Trying to get everything buttoned up and making sure we haven't missed anything. Above all, though, we can't wait for the moment when we can invite you to explore this new adventure we've prepared in our game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647114/756f2eb3e877c939c667d6c9e3d948ef42c0f032.png

Compared to the demo version, we've made several significant changes related to controls, especially concerning gamepad handling. Thanks to your valuable suggestions, we've completely rebuilt the magic usage mechanics and expanded the mapping settings, allowing for the assignment of magic usage to additional mouse buttons. Moreover, the aim assist system has been significantly improved, which should further enhance gameplay comfort.

Two weeks ago, we also had the pleasure of participating in PAX EAST in Boston. We'd like to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who visited our booth and shared their impressions of the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and has contributed to the refinement of our product.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647114/6900caf796a2fe6d0bb5a7c2bd3aaa6cad24f336.png

See you in 3 days! Be ready for an unforgettable adventure!

notes.title: First hands-on at PGA 2023!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

First hands-on with a new game is always a super stressful moment for the creator. You can't make any more changes, all you can do is watch and gather feedback. For us, the first time we publicly presented "Yet Another Fantasy Title" to players was at our local video game trade show - PGA.

During the three days of the event, hundreds of people played YAFT and shared their impressions and ideas for improvements. We don't want to jinx it, but we think it went pretty well!

Watch the video relation!
[previewyoutube=vjgs0bgQIzE;full][/previewyoutube]

We're still working on the game as we have loads of new ideas! We can't wait to finally drop the demo for everyone here on Steam. We'll do it during the upcoming 'Next' festival, which kicks off in early February.

notes.title: Let us introduce you to the best PR manager in town, Eliandra!
notes.content:
Hello Wizards and Thugs,
Wit, spice, and a good price... These were the ingredients to create the perfect... PR manager? Saving the world anywhere and anytime. And with some unusual methods, indeed. That's what makes a good PR manager, though. Who would like to see the same cliche marketing phrases saying that you're the greatest hero of them all when you can just dress as a werebeaver, scare some local elves and dwarfs, and later pretend you've killed the furry bastard? Yeah, everyone knows that werebeavers aren't real, but who says you can't prove them wrong? Or maybe they are indeed real and very much alive? Ooops...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647114/e42134990d4997b9bb92d8a9eef1730f962120f7.jpg

Meet Eliandra
Eliandra is an elegant, good-looking elven lady who knows her way with words. Trust me, you would believe in every shitty story she tells you without even a moment of hesitation. 
Her earnings come mainly from making up facts and lying to people. She doesn't even waste time anymore to think if something is true or false. What matters, is the final effect her clients require. You could even say that Challenge is her second name. The bigger the nonsense she has to sell, the more excited she gets. If there was a Nobel prize for being able to sell everybody everything and make them pay thrice the required amount for it, she would win it without a doubt.
Oh, and she has the werebeaver outfit at home. Don't ask us where did she get it from, though.

Eliandra's story
It all started with working for the king. The young elven copywriter first wrote articles for the city council. Her talent soon became known throughout the industry, and she began writing articles for royal heralds. Her reputation preceded her so much that soon she got assigned to the most difficult task in the entire kingdom's history - preventing the consequences of the Great Incest Crisis. You don't know what it was? Well, thank Eliandra!

notes.title: Let's get it started! Meet Grindalf, the Wizard
notes.content:
Hello Magicians and Thugs, 
Let's get this magical party started, shall we? Since we announced Yet Another Fantasy Title in July 2022, you have given us a lot of love! Your interest in the game is also quite a big thing for us. After all, the YAFT trailer was one of the most viewed (907k views!) game trailers on IGN's Youtube channel in July 2022! Thank you for that! 

[previewyoutube=qtZfmiSXKmY;full][/previewyoutube]

Let me tell you a story about Grindalf
Once upon a time, before the Dragon ate the King, Grindalf was the most powerful wizard in the kingdom. The Court Wizard. A living legend. His successful experiments were taking everyone's breaths away, and those unsuccessful ones were getting so cleverly hidden that no one really cared. When he declared: "You shall not pass!", even the king himself tiptoed around the land. 
Today, Grindalf is a weird old man known for nice fireworks shows. At first glance, he's done with wizarding. At a second glance as well. Sometimes, however, you need to look thrice.

Let us know what you think about Grindalf! Will he become our hero's best friend, a mentor everyone else can only dream of, or the worst nightmare of an enemy?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647114/d31a67f628e1d9159a4c28155b95e25247ec33f7.jpg

Meanwhile...
Remember to add Yet Another Fantasy Title to your wishlist and spread the word about it! Make everyone around hear about the elixir-loving Magician and the Thug who killed The Chosen One.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1993450

And for now, let us pull you up a chair and invite you for yet one more fireworks show pulled off by Grindalf himself! Which will happen when he's ready. One day. Hopefully.

May the Grindalf be with you!
(Or maybe it would be better if he wasn't?)
Yet Another Fantasy Title team
